name: architecture-review
title: Architecture review

reader_outcome.audience: A reviewer distinguishing a proposed change from its constraints and controls.
reader_outcome.outcome: The reviewer can distinguish the proposed change, constraints, operational controls, and contingency without losing implementation facts.

preserve: Every source fact, actor, requirement, quantity, condition, and commitment
do_not_add: Decision, approval state, or risk rating

sequence: Group operational impact with required notice controls
rhetorical_shape.ending: Isolate the contingency at the end.

editing_posture.role: Clarify the architecture review record rather than persuade.
editing_posture.change_scope: Split mixed purposes while preserving implementation facts and relationships.
allowed_moves: Keep each control owner beside the control
Separate the contingency from the main proposal
prohibited_moves: Add approval, ratification, or recommendation language
Invent mitigation, assurance, evidence, or trade-offs
Use decorative labels that could be parsed as new claims

observable_tendencies.reason: A review record should identify the proposed implementation before constraints and controls.
Permit and budget facts define the implementation boundary.
Ownership must remain explicit without adding governance claims.
The conditional fallback should remain distinct from the proposed change.

positive_guidance: Keep the facilities team, project manager, permit, inspections, budget, closure, notice period, weather condition, and fallback.
Group permit and budget constraints after the proposed change.
Keep the project manager beside the schedule and notice controls.
negative_guidance: Do not invent architecture terminology, assurance, ratification, or mitigation.
Do not add evidence, trade-offs, risk ratings, or a review recommendation.
Do not turn labels into claims about approval or implementation status.

positive_examples.text: In October 2026, the facilities team will replace two rooftop heating and cooling units at the North Campus library.
positive_examples.reason: It keeps the proposed change, actor, timing, quantity, and target first.

negative_examples.text: Recommendation: Approve the resilient HVAC architecture because the operational risks are fully mitigated.
negative_examples.reason: It invents a recommendation, architecture framing, assurance, and mitigation claim.
